# Contributing

Thanks for helping keep this list sharp.

## Adding a tool

1. One tool per line, in the right section:
   `[name](https://github.com/owner/repo) ⭐stars — what it does, concretely.`
2. Requirements:
   - Open source, or a meaningful free tier with an open client.
   - Actively maintained (pushed within the last 12 months).
   - Description states what it does — no "powerful/easy/seamless" filler.
3. Agent-native tools (Claude Code skills, MCP servers, CLI-first) get priority — that's this list's edge.
4. Sort within a section by stars, descending.

## Updating star counts

Bulk star refreshes welcome. Note the harvest date in the README intro line when you do.

## Removing a tool

Open an issue or PR if a tool is abandoned (no pushes >18 months), relicensed to closed source, or superseded.
